# Waycord

> Waycord is an AI-orchestrated, offline-first task management workspace built for speed, focus, and collaboration.

## Overview
Waycord turns natural language into structured milestones, tracks execution velocity, and enables seamless team collaboration with zero operational noise — even offline.

## Core Capabilities
- [Task Management](https://waycord.org/): Offline-first task management with instant local persistence.
- [AI Orchestration](https://waycord.org/): Natural language task breakdown powered by Gemini.
- [Team Workspaces](https://waycord.org/): Real-time collaborative workspace with role-based access control.

- [Privacy Policy](https://waycord.org/privacy): Waycord privacy and data protection terms.
